name: Port & LED Tester
author: joeskolengaden
description: Lights up one physical output port at a time (or all ports at once) and steps through pixels one-by-one so you can visually count how many LEDs on a strand actually light up. Pure UI plugin - drives FPP's own built-in /api/testmode, no fppd changes required. Records per-port configured-vs-observed counts so you can spot dead sections at a glance.
